source_findings.idea: Unoffset lookahead_on CURRENT HTF O/H/L/C appended at period START; live samples only developing values then frozen. Arrays append chronologically, filter iterates oldest-first and breaks at60 matches: actual FIRST60 like-slot observations forever, not recent60. source_findings.idea: Auto HTF1min→15,3→30,5→60,15→240,30/60→D,240/480→W,D→M; other→W. Prior4H/D/W/M H/L use offset[1]+lookahead_on. Log midpoint = geometric midpoint of dominant wick if its loglength exceeds body, else sqrt(HL).
source_findings.rationale: Retain landmark, morphology and adaptive wick/range midpoint benchmarks with explicit source/availability. '8am Futures' is a source landmark, not universal exchange open. Double-sweep-inside bias gets upper-raid bearish precedence; later both-sweep wick rule is effectively unreachable for ordinary valid OHLC. Separate both sides and order/close-position instead of silently enforcing precedence. Log midpoint requires positive prices; compare arithmetic wick/range/body geometry and volatility-normalized distances. Auto TF mapping is a tunable source choice, not market law.

source_findings.idea: Separate5min/60min three-candle nonoverlap FVGs (newL>oldH, newH<oldL); previous-bar request uses default lookahead_off. New period detected by OHLC VALUE change, so identical candles disappear; duplicate if EITHER boundary matches any existing gap. Strict full-far-edge wick breach deletes, equality survives. Last/realtime HTF panel draws current-developing FVG and adjacent BODY gaps with overlapping wicks called 'Volume Imbalance'.
source_findings.rationale: Retain price-gap/body-gap objects, never label as measured traded-volume imbalance. Use candle IDs and true completion timestamps, exact three consecutive periods, dimensions, partial fill/retest/full fill/invalidation and expiry; retain equal-boundary but distinct origins. Offset+lookahead_off can delay historical availability relative to live; canonical aggregation removes lag/parity ambiguity. MTF max inputs unused and arrays unbounded; chart time[2] backanchor is not originating HTF time. Compare real low-volume/delta nodes as richer independent measurements, and require conditional future reaction/payoff tests.

source_findings.idea: At new HTF, last completed B versus predecessor A: bearish B.H>A.H, B.C<A.H, B.C<mid(B); bullish lower mirror. Exclude B sweeping BOTH A edges and closing strictly inside. Zone between B.C and mid(B), available next HTF. One pattern per period; bearish checked first. Standard C2 label at B extreme, C3 at new boundary.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve standard completed raid→return→close-side-of-midpoint zone, including both-sweep exclusion, strict equalities and manual directional bias. Market event occurs when conditions known, not backdated C2 extreme label. Study both-sweep as its own expert instead of blanket exclusion; compare midpoint variants, latent auction state, options/flow conditioning and unconfirmed versus confirmed payoff. No actual stop inventory is observed.

source_findings.idea: CISD starts at matched extreme chart bar C2, extends backward through up to20 opposite-direction candles, uses body envelope by default or wick envelope (C2 wick mode initially only extreme point). Finds first close beyond envelope from C2 through current detection bar. Projects .5/1/1.5/2×envelope range beyond broken edge. findLevelBarIndex searches last100 ANY equal H/L with persistent prior result if none found.
source_findings.rationale: Retain opposite-candle run envelope→close break and range projections; exact match must use stored originating extreme event ID, not another equal-price bar. Scan-on-recognition can backdraw a break that occurred before HTF setup known: earliest joint decision is max(setup known_at, break known_at), never retrospective fill. Retest subsequent CISD if not broken at initial recognition (source only calls once) is our extension. Test doji run membership, wick C2 initialization, zero range, nonnumeric projection input, >100-bar origin and repeated equal highs/lows.

source_findings.idea: Denominator increments at formation START; all-history rates include incomplete and invalid sessions. Clear stale range/level; count only matured eligible forecasts, preserve no-touch and incomplete statuses rather than denominator max1→0% display. Tests at day boundary, missing formation/end, straddle gaps, zero range, equal touch, overlapping conditions and repeated return; source proportions are reach hypotheses, not reversal/trading success.

source_findings.rationale: Retain causal completed snapshot lifecycle with actual period ID, dates, coverage, units, grid and known_at. Compare levels and whole shape across aligned tick grids, not screen width; each widget independently max-normalizes, obscuring absolute participation. Test month/week/year transitions, gap/holiday/DST, incomplete first period, rolling eviction, no-volume period and replay. source_findings.idea: NY08–16, London02–08, Asia20–02; captures all hourly opens/H/L18→08, but draws only midnight through07 opens and completed-hour midpoints at08. Use coverage/date IDs and UI-independent formation; nearest-level effect needs density/distance/time/width-matched placebos and sequential selection, not rate-only ranking.

source_findings.idea: Break SIDE from chart high first (bull-side precedence if both), but timestamp is first1min bar breaking EITHER edge; can label high break with time of earlier low break. Break bar entirely skips invalidation/target testing. Later bars use current-bar extension, not peak-to-date, then invalidation checked before midpoint; samebar sequence unresolved. One-sided target exceedance can count gap past midpoint without traded touch.
source_findings.rationale: Use chronological ticks or conservative interval ambiguity, first-side/order identities and joint known_at; one-minute bar-open timestamp is interval-censored, not exact trade event or chart-decision time. Tests lower-first then upper in samechartbar, break-and-return/stop in breakbar, samebar competing barriers, later lower extension than prior peak, gap across target and no-touch timeout. No retrospective entry at break timestamp recognized later. Separate current displacement from maximum excursion; calibrate remaining payoff after any confirmation.
